properties.name: 18/00518/FUL
properties.notes: Covers Silverdale site (MEL 5) (former LCC ACS residential home) and adjoingng Catherine Dalley site (former LCC care home). LCC agreed disposal as a single site in June 2017; sold 2 sites together to McCarthy & Stone in 2017. All proposed private housing for older people; currently with DV for independent viability assessment re affordable housing financial contribution. Number of TPOs restrict overall development on Silverdale side of site. PIP not propsed given site is currently pending FUL planning application and partially benefits from Local Plan allocation MEL5. Register submission altered from previous years entry to reflect enlarged site and new planning application. Site under construction. Work started, site removed from list
properties.site-address: Catherine Dalley & Silverdale, Scalford Road, Melton Mowbray
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
